TUSIENGGIPA NITOGIPA ME TRA Changsao a'song damsao saksa raja aro rani dongachim.
kusi ongoba uamangni mingsa dukba dongachim ; maina uamango saksamangba de dongpakujachim.
Ruuta bilsini ja'manosa uamango demechik saksa atchiaha.
Raja aro rani da'o mairongpile kusi ongbeaha.
Uamangni kusi ong-ako agannan amsokpiljachim.
Uni songnokni a'song gimikon rajani demechik atchiako knae pilakan kusi ongtokbeaha aro songantion kusi ong'a aro katchaani kontarangko dokaha.
Raja antangni a'songo donggipa manderangna, kangal segri aro bi-sa ma'grinaba cha'a-ringanirangko indin chana-ringna on-ataha.
Salsao ia me-chik bi'sako napolatani salo raja kusi ongbee, dalbea alaniko dake a'songni dal-dalgipa mande- rangko okamtokaha.

Manderangna agreba, ua a'songni mite sa'grerangkoba ia Rani bisani mite ma'giparang ong'e, uko namao re-dilchina aro nitimgiparang ong'china ong'e, uko namao redilchina aro nitimgiparang ong-china okamchappaha.
Uni a'songo sakchigitam mite sa'grerang gnangchim.
Mingsa dukni katta ian chong'motan, raja uamangko okamahaoba uo uamangna chachakna tala kingchigni aro ringchakna glas ge-chignisan dongaiachim.
Uni gimin raja mite sagre saksakode watchangdraen, an'tango donga kakket onchakanirang gita sakchignikosan okamatna manaiaha.
Rajani okamako mangipa sakchigni mite sagreraig gamchatbatsranggipa on'anirangko rae rajani alaona re-baha.
Rani bi-sako tuatram palangona re'ange, uamang --- Page 8 --- MINGSINGGIPA GOLPORANG sakprakprakan an'tangtangni on-aniko on-na a'bachengaha.

Skanggipa una jringnaan nitokamaianiko, sakgipin gisik gnanganiko, gitamgipa ka'saaniko, brigipa man'e-cha:aniko, uandaken sakantian an-tangtangni on'aniko on'angtokeng- mitingo chignigipa sagreni pal soknasion, Rani bi-sako tuatram kuturini do'gako otingtrangbae chigitamgipa mite sa'gresa napdrabaha.

Ua rajani alaona an'tangko okampajaana ka-onangtee Rani bisako tuatram palangona tongtong re-angari bisani kosako an'tangni jakrangko wingwange chrikwate inaha, "Nangna gamchatgipa on'anirangko on'giminrang mingsaba mamungba ong'jachina, batesa nangni bilsi chibonga ong' ahaon, charanggani silbusu nang jaksio bue rang'san sichina.
Nang'pani angko chonnikana ian angni ajak sokskaanj ong'a." Indine aganari ua an'pildate ong'katsrapgijan ua uisogija re-baiahachim, uandaken re-angpiloba pilakba uko nikrikgijan gimaangaiaha.
Raja, rani aro uni dal-dalgipa manderang ia namgija- gipa mite sa'greni kattarangko knaarion duk ongtokbeaha aro jajrengan gaptokaha.
Bakgitchak raniba palangtango.
ia namgijagipa mite sa'greni sao onako uirikpaha ina gita grappaaha.
Kusi onge, doke dame katchaa-kusi ong-ani- rangba bondike grapa kalimanisan ongpilaiaha.
Raja, danang, ranini ia bisana patiarangko rabana mangsonge dakpaaniara saksakamkam demechikko sao man-ate siatani- onasa bikpilatani ongpilskaiaha !

Indake grap-kalimmitingo, chignigipa mite sagre re'- mikkangbae inaha, “"Anga molmola, na'simangara indima- sikde grap-kalimtokpanabeda, An-chingni ka'sagipa Rani bi-sa on'anggimin saoko anga pegaltokna manjaoba, uni signionimangmangkode jokatpana mangen.

Rani bi-sani bilsi chibongao charanggani silbusu uni jaksio bue siani pal., ua aro rajani nokgimikan ritchasa bilsina tusigripsrangani ong'skachina." --- Page 9 --- MINGSINGGIPA GOLPORANG Raja an'tangni demechikna ongimin saooniko uko jokatna man'na gita, uni a'song gimikonikon pilak charang- garangko chimongtoke so'e galchina, aro je mandean uni ge'etaniko manija, ukode so-ote galchina hukumko on-ataha.
Rajani ge'etako man'arion a'song gimikon ge'saba dongpil- gija charanggarangko chimongtoke so'e galbebeaha.
Indake dakmano rani bi-sani saooniko jokatna man-chongmotgen ine raja ka'dongbeahachim.
Rani bisani sao on'gimin bilsiona sokkujana kingking nitobegipa, nambegipa, gisik gnangbegipa aro manderangni ka'saako mangipa onge ua dalrorobaha.

Indiba mal ka'gen, rajani kadongsoa gita onggija, namgijagipa mite sa'grcni on'gimin saoko jitatna manjajok.Daalde bilsi chibonga ong'gnok inani salo Rani bi'sa, pilak un baksa gimikkon wate saksan pagipani nok gimikko aro uni gam- rang gimikkon uina sikani gisik uo nabaha.
Nok gimikkon re-roroe niani ja'mano, bonkamao ua kosakbatgipa prot- chongni kuturiona jangkirangko gadoangaha.
Uano pagipa maiko donengachim uko ua uina sikbeaha; maina ua mamung saloba ua protchongona gadoange nikujachim.
Ua kuturiona napangon Rani bisa janggil kom-chikgipa buchuma saksani kilding rikengakosa nikeaha.
Ua pangnaba kilding rikako nikpakujachim.
Uni gimin ua aiao inman- bee singaha, Aiao uara mai?
Na'a uchi maiko dakenga, ambi ?" "Dede, iara kilding rikani charanggasaba" ine bochuma aganchakaha.
“Naaba rike nipana sikama ?
Ia kamde altuabeaba,pilakan changaigen.Indake kilko rime wilwilataibo, unon kilding ong'kataigen'.
Gisik ra-bo, ia buchumara gipinde ongjachim.
Namgijagipa mite sagresa an'tangni sao on'ako chu'sokatna mangsonge an·tangko buchuma dake kilding rika dakmaengasachim.
Rani bi-sa aiao inmanpile, kilding rike nipana ine charanggaona re-angaha.
Ua charanggako dangtape kilding rikpana joton --- Page 10 --- MINGSINGGIPA GOLPORANG ka'on, chranggani silbususa uni jaksio busoaiaha.
Bua mananikon rani bi'sa sepango donggipa asongchakanio gitilwatari, ruutbegipa tusijripaniko tusijripna draatako manaha.Rangsananrajani nokgimikantusisripna a-bachengtokaha.

Raja aro uni daldalgipa manderang, rani aro uko nitimgipa me-chikrang, chakkol-nokkolrang, babil- sio song'gipa-changiparang, nokkingsako ba'e mikoenggipa parroarang, gurerangba noltangtango, song'timgipa an tangna dakchakgipa mea bi'sako, uni daksretanina nachil salna nachilo rim'a gnangan tusichipangaha.
Manderangna agre, menggo, achak, ben'chidik aro tampi bilrorogipaba gimik gimangan, nokgimik-jamgimikan muni nangako mantoke ruutbegipa tusijripaniona tusimipekangtokaha.
Kusi ong'- begipa knatoriri ring'anirang, katchae doka-damanirang, gamchipchipan gapgipa rajani nokara, ka'sindikdik, jrim- jrim, galchipgimin nok gitasa dakaiaha.
Adita salrangni jamanon, ia rajani nokni samtangchin burungni bu'su- raragipa golaprangsa chaduule wegadona a-bachengskaha.
Bilsi bilsi chadaprikrike wedapdapgriko, chubee wegadogi- parang ja'manode rajani nokkon nikpilgija wepriptokaha.
Uarang guare kaduulgimin gita ongpilahachim.
Bilsi ritchasani ja'manode uano rajani nok dongachim ine uina mamung chinba dongjajok.
Bu'suarigipa golaprangsa dikpripaiahachim.
Ia tusijripgipa ranini nitoako aro una onggimin obos- tani kattarangko pilakchin knaangtokaha.

Sepango aro chel-ao donggipa kadonggipa raja panterang ia ong'a obostarangko nina rebatokaha, aro montrochi chaatgipa bu'suraragipa golaprangko chilprete, tusijriptokgipa rajani nokona napangna joton katokaha.
Saksamangba golap- rangko pe-e napangna aro ong'katpile katnaba man'srangjae, uanon janggitangtangkosa galtokna nangaiahachim.
Indaken bilsi ritchasa ongnasiaona kingking bilsi re-- angani ja'mano chel-a a'songni saksa nitobegipa raja panteba
